name: MEMCOMPILER_SCIENCEWORLD_EVAL_MEMORY_STATE_SIDECAR_INTEGRATION_V1
purpose: Make future ScienceWorld evaluation claims about fixed retrieved memory, same-M comparisons and selected-memory effects replay-auditable without changing the receiver prompt or policy behavior.
behavior_preservation_constraints: Do not change retrieval query text, successful_topk, failed_topk, insight_topk, threshold, task-graph traversal or LLM reranking prompts/settings.
Do not add provenance IDs or digests to task_memory strings, Manager prompts, Executor prompts or model-visible trajectory text.
Do not change UPDATE_MEMORY behavior; record it explicitly instead.
Do not sort/reorder the actual retrieved candidates for execution. Any sorting used for snapshot canonicalization must operate only on copied provenance records.
Do not change environment seeds, ScienceWorld task/variation/simplification, reset calls, action ordering, model sampling or checkpoint loading.
A provenance-write failure must not be silently interpreted as evidence for same-M or same-selected-memory claims.

run_level_fields.scienceworld_runtime_artifact_sha256: exact wheel/sdist/JAR bundle digest where available
run_level_fields.update_memory: effective boolean, not source-code default inferred later
run_level_fields.memory_persist_directory: logical run-local identifier; do not rely on mutable path name as identity
run_level_fields.memory_snapshot_pre_run_sha256: canonical snapshot digest before first evaluation episode
run_level_fields.retrieval_config_sha256: canonical digest of retrieval hyperparameters plus reranker/model identity
run_level_fields.run_condition_id: full/AMMI/no-memory/etc. exact condition label and implementation revision

memory_snapshot_canonicalization.minimum_main_memory: Read main_memory.get() into a provenance-only copy containing ids, documents and metadatas. Canonicalize each record as {backend_id, page_content_sha256, canonical_metadata_sha256}; sort the copied records by backend_id and hash the canonical JSON list.
memory_snapshot_canonicalization.retrieval_affecting_auxiliary_state: Also bind task-layer graph and any insight-layer state used by retrieval/reranking. A digest of main_memory alone is insufficient if task-graph or insight state can change candidate selection.
memory_snapshot_canonicalization.privacy_and_context: Persist hashes/IDs in the sidecar; raw memory text may stay in the normal DB/artifact store. Do not inject snapshot metadata into the model context.

per_episode_fields.task_query_sha256: digest of the exact query_task bytes passed to retrieve_memory
per_episode_fields.memory_snapshot_pre_retrieval_sha256: snapshot immediately before the one episode-start retrieval
per_episode_fields.ordered_candidates: for every returned success/failure memory item, preserve returned order and record receiver-visible content digest plus persistent backend ID when available; record insight identities/digests separately
per_episode_fields.candidate_pool_sha256: digest of the ordered returned-candidate identity/content records exactly as delivered to the episode
per_episode_fields.task_memory_prompt_sha256: digest of exact model-visible task_memory rendering, if a renderer is used
per_episode_fields.compiler_step_records: per step: observation/state digest, selector/compiler revision, compiler output/guidance digest, executor input digest, and selected persistent record ID only if explicit selection can be observed without changing behavior
per_episode_fields.memory_update_event: whether memory.add_memory executed after the episode, canonical inserted-content digest, and post-update memory snapshot digest
per_episode_fields.memory_snapshot_post_episode_sha256: snapshot after all update/backward effects for the episode

backend_identity_capture.observed_gap: Current retrieval converts Chroma Documents to MASMessage metadata and drops backend IDs before returning.
backend_identity_capture.preferred_hook: Instrument the retrieval layer on a provenance-only branch at the point where each Document still has access to storage identity, or query a copied backend result mapping that binds returned Document content/metadata to the corresponding backend ID without altering result ordering.
backend_identity_capture.fallback: If exact backend ID cannot be obtained without changing retrieval behavior, record canonical receiver-visible content digests and classify evidence only as same-content, not same-persistent-record.

claim_tiers.requirements: one episode-start retrieval plus no re-retrieval or mutation of the returned task_memory object during that episode
claim_tiers.does_not_imply: same underlying memory bank across episodes or conditions

claim_tiers.requirements: same task/query/retrieval config and identical ordered candidate receiver-content digests for the paired conditions
claim_tiers.does_not_imply: same persistent backend records when duplicate/equivalent records may exist

claim_tiers.requirements: identical ordered backend IDs + content digests, compatible pre-retrieval memory snapshot, and bound update/freeze policy
claim_tiers.does_not_imply: same per-step selected member if compilation selection is implicit

claim_tiers.requirements: all prior bindings plus identical selected persistent record, compiled guidance and pre-effect executor state; only receiver effect differs
claim_tiers.does_not_imply: scientific generalization beyond the tested environment/task distribution

current_public_output_gap: Count-only task_memory_summary cannot satisfy any cross-condition same-M claim above fixed-within-episode pool. It must not be upgraded to candidate identity evidence.
historical_boundary: This sidecar makes future runs auditable. It cannot retroactively bind the reported Table-3 run to the current public runner, UPDATE_MEMORY setting, local DB path or candidate pool without a separate author-published bridge artifact.
next_action: Search public model/dataset/repository history for a Table-3 bridge containing the ScienceWorld memory DB or candidate-pool/run manifest. If absent, treat the future-run instrumentation route as specified and continue searching for another science-domain system with already-published selected-memory identities and fixed-bank matched ablation.
